attributes.action: Cap Uber and other private-hire platforms’ commission at 20%
attributes.additional_details: Private-hire drivers rely on ride-hailing apps for their income, but high and variable commission charges can leave drivers with too little after fuel, insurance, vehicle finance, maintenance, licensing and other costs. We believe drivers should receive a fairer share of the fares they earn. We ask the Government to introduce a maximum 20% commission or service fee for Uber and other ride-hailing platforms, with clear fare and commission information for every journey.
attributes.background: Introduce legislation to cap the commission or service fees that Uber and other private-hire and ride-hailing platforms can charge drivers at a maximum of 20% of each passenger fare.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a very similar action:

Introduce 25% commission rate cap for private hire (ride hailing companies) 
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/769002
